title: Kobra Asset Manifest
description: Companion to game/assets/asset.manifest.json. The single source of truth for asset discovery; the engine MUST NOT hardcode asset paths (spec Sections 9.2, Appendix B.2). Hashes are ADVISORY for assets (FR-AST-4); mods may override them (FR-AST-8).

content_addressed.description: When true, asset paths embed a hash prefix and are served immutable (FR-AST-9).

bundles.description: Packed small-file bundles (FR-AST-10). Assets at or under the bundling threshold appear in a bundle instead of as individual files.

hash.description: ADVISORY (FR-AST-4). A mismatch logs a warning and the file the user supplied is used; the game MUST NOT refuse to start or degrade gameplay because of it.

mutable.description: False marks an asset the engine requires structurally. Use sparingly: every mutable:false asset is a mod that cannot work (FR-AST-7).

cache.description: Cache-Control directive the server applies (FR-SRV-15). immutable requires a content-addressed or release-prefixed path.

bundle.description: Path of the bundle containing this asset, when bundled.

preload.description: Hint that the asset is needed for the first frame and should be fetched during splash.

range_requests.description: True for audio/video that must support seeking (FR-SRV-14, Section 17.2).

relPath.description: POSIX-style relative path. No leading slash, no backslash, no empty or dot segments, ASCII-only by policy (FR-I18N-7). The negative lookahead rejects '.' and '..' segments so a crafted manifest cannot escape its root.
